summary: The current advice is to wait before buying any Indian stock, though HDFC Bank is the preferred choice if investing anyway, while in the US the pick is to buy JPMorgan Chase cautiously. Analysts are discussing how high market fear and rising interest rates make risky bets dangerous right now. They note that most Indian bank stocks grow too slowly to multiply money quickly, and volatile companies like Nvidia or Exide Industries can drop sharply without warning.
